description: Commerce Assurance: submit one invoice, one payment or transfer record and an optional receipt. The signed report compares amount, currency, payer, payee, reference and date, itemizing every difference: a short or over payment with the amount, a currency that differs, a payer or payee that differs by name or account, a missing or different reference, and a payment before issue or after the due date. Verdict exact, partial or mismatch. POST /api/invoice-payment-match. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no counterparty contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/commerce-assurance-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.
